description.en: Mauritania, officially the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, is a country in the Maghreb region of West Africa. It is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the west, Western Sahara to the north and northwest, Algeria to the northeast, Mali to the east and southeast, and Senegal to the southwest.
description.zh-CN: 毛里塔尼亚伊斯兰共和国，通稱毛里塔尼亞，是位於西非的國家，也是非洲的马格里布阿拉伯国家之一。与阿尔及利亚、馬利、塞内加尔和西撒哈拉争议地区接壤。
description.zh-TW: 毛里塔尼亞伊斯蘭共和國，通稱毛裏塔尼亞，是位於西非的國家，也是非洲的馬格里布阿拉伯國家之一。與阿爾及利亞、馬利、塞內加爾和西撒哈拉爭議地區接壤。

photo.alt: "Gen. Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz in his home city Akjoujt, Mauritania, 15 Mar 2009" Note that the man at right is in the distinctive grey uniform of an officer of the Mauritanian Armed Forces. "General Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz said Saturday the military would proceed with the plan for presidential elections on June 6, saying the polls would be free and fair, and open to all. Speaking at a rally in his native city of Akjoujt , General Aziz said Mauritanians have the duty to register and to vote for the candidate they feel will best lead the country forward."
